title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. translated_title: 因果世界模型何时能帮助模块化LLM智能体
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地通过模块化系统来执行操作，例如订单、支付、库存和发货服务，其中一个模块中的动作会改变另一个模块中哪些状态转移是有效的。标准世界模型通常拟合观测性轨迹，但这并非干预时规划所需的量：一条轨迹可能显示支付先于发货，却无法识别究竟是支付授权了发货、库存中介了这一效应，还是一个隐藏的触发因素同时解释了两者。我们通过FedCausalCompose来研究这一差距，这是一个面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架，其中本地动作为跨模块接口提供干预-响应证据。我们首先证明，在后门路径未被阻断时，观测性世界模型会产生不可消除的干预误差；接口恢复质量随干预-响应覆盖率的提升而改善；并且当覆盖率足够时，基于因果组合的oracle方法可以超越非因果方法的下界。
tldr: 该论文提出面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架FedCausalCompose，证明观测性世界模型在存在未阻断后门路径时具有不可消除的干预误差，而利用本地动作的干预-响应证据对跨模块接口进行因果组合，可以突破这一下界并提升干预时规划能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents, showing that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, while causal composition of cross-module interfaces using local intervention-response evidence can surpass this lower bound and improve intervention-time planning.
